additional_info.subject: 0414360 - ID0414343-DC/Si-D/FR-[jRLjhx]- Card reader is defect (C1) CRM:00314000153
additional_info.body:
Good morning Bastien,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services Team in regards of child ticket
ID0414360
. The ticket was opened for the error flag ‘PaymentTerminalCardReaderDefect_PZx’ changed to true - (Card reader is defect.), on charger
jRLjhx.
From your email, I understood that the issue appears when, on the HMI, the credit card payment option is selected, it is aborted, and when selected again the terminal is not reachable anymore.
Could you please clarify what do you mean with “the payment option is aborted”? Today I remotely connected to the charger via ssh, I reproduced the steps that you described by interacting with the HMI remotely several times, but I was not able to reproduce the issue. In particular:
When I select the credit card option, cancel the selection and select it again, I have the log line saying: Cashier canceled  while waiting for card insertion.
When I select the credit card option, wait for the authentication timeout and select it again, I have the log line saying: terminal communication timeout.
As you can see, these actions do not trigger an error flag “PaymentTerminalCardReaderDefect_PZx”, so please clarify how the error flag is triggered.
I had a look at the timestamp that you reported, and what I notice is the activation of the error flag but without any interaction in terms of credit card terminal selection. So, I believe in this case, that the error flag appeared because for an instance the reader was non communicating with the payment terminal.
As last point, I also had a look on AWS to monitor the activation of the error flag, as you mentioned that you noticed it since the installation of FW 6.1.3.
I saw that the FW 6.1.3 was installed on 17.03.2025, but I see that this error flag appeared also before the installation of FW 6.1.3, so I would exclude it was introduced by the new FW.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon!

additional_info.subject: RE: 0414360 - ID0414343-DC/Si-D/FR-[jRLjhx]- Card reader is defect (C1) CRM:00314000153
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Bastien,
I had the chance to watch the video you sent me and to analyze the related logs on charger
wuhEnE.
In the video I saw for two times that, when aborting the payment option, it took nearly one minute for the HMI to recover from the de-selection of the payment option.
However, from the logs on SCB, I cannot see anything wrong:
All the aborted pre-authorization are processed correctly. Two Parsing errors appeared, corresponding to the two times the charger took a little longer to recover from the abortion. These errors appeared because of the high solicitation of the terminal and charger to process the requested authorization and abortion. However, no error flag related to the Payment terminal was raised.
Therefore, I believe that the error flag “
PaymentTerminalCardReaderDefect_PZx”, for which this ticket was opened, does not appear when the payment option is stressfully selected and aborted, as per the video, but it appears due to a temporary interruption of communication between the payment terminal and the payment reader.
As per my first analysis and email, for example, the error flag on the terminal was active for circa 13 seconds, and it is reported that “the card reader does not answer”:
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon.
W
